before.text: What the hell is going on over there?
I need a status report immediately.
Once these kids wake up, I'll have them give you a report.
You'd better not be doing a sloppy job.
Saint Saturn had better be safe.
What happened to the power plant?
Have you ever been ordered to kill your best friend?
That's one hell of a head you've got there.
I know the government really wants me for my brain, but I need funding.
You realize I'm an admiral now, don't you?
Don't want to drop those on your foot.
So this is your plan for the island?
Yes, I'm going to name it Egghead.
If you burn it down, you'll set scientific progress back essentially.
You think I did a sloppy job?
If you have time to sit there and tell me.
Then you come here and look at what I've done!
